```yaml
name: Deploy Questarr

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build the project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v2
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: docker build -t doezer/questarr:${{ github.sha }} .

      - name: Push Docker image
        run: docker push doezer/questarr:${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Deploy to production
        run: |
          docker stop questarr || true
          docker rm questarr || true
          docker run -d --name questarr -p 80:80 -e HOST=0.0.0.0 doezer/questarr:${{ github.sha }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow allows you to deploy the Questarr web app on demand by pushing a new commit or manually triggering the workflow through the GitHub UI. The workflow includes steps to checkout the code, set up Node.js, install dependencies, build the project, log in to Docker Hub, build the Docker image, push the image to Docker Hub, and finally deploy the image to production using Docker.
